import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sqrt(t); s1=np.sqrt(1+t)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3
            + s*(p[4]+p[5]*P+p[6]*P**2+p[7]*np.sqrt(P))
            + s1*(p[8]*P+p[9]*P*np.log(P)))
